LESSON: SIGN READING 11..4.1 INTENSIVE SIGN READING: DILEMMA NARRATIVES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Sign Reading 11..4.1 Intensive sign reading: Dilemma Narratives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 11..4.1 Intensive sign reading: Dilemma Narratives, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to study dilemma narrative?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise signs of vocabulary related to dilemma narratives for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sign Reading 11..4.1 Intensive sign reading: Dilemma Narratives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. describe the characters in a given dilemma narrative,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sign Reading 11..4.1 Intensive sign reading: Dilemma Narratives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 11..4.1 Intensive sign reading: Dilemma Narratives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

• Self Efficacy: Learner develops the skill of self awareness as they dramatise parts of the dilemma narrative

Values:
• Respect: is enhanced as learner understands and appreciates others as they carry out group discussions

Link to other Subjects

• The learner is able to relate the concept of narratives to their learning in Creative Arts and Kiswahili.
